title: Лесенка: Lifestyles
description: Наступай на ступеньки, подсвечивая слова. Лесенка 1 — здоровый образ жизни (снизу-вверх), Лесенка 2 — день школьника (сверху-вниз)

ladders.title: Активный образ жизни (снизу вверх)
steps: I go jogging in the park.
I go jogging in the park in the morning.
I go jogging in the park in the morning three times a week.
I go jogging in the park in the morning and play volleyball at the weekend.
I go jogging in the park, play volleyball and visit the sports centre with my friends.
I go jogging in the park, play volleyball, visit the sports centre and eat healthy food.
I lead an active lifestyle: I go jogging, play volleyball, visit the sports centre and eat healthy food.

ladders.title: День школьника (сверху вниз)
steps: On a school day, I get up early, go to school, do my homework, meet my friends and go to bed at ten.
On a school day, I get up early, go to school, do my homework and meet my friends.
On a school day, I get up early, go to school and do my homework.
On a school day, I get up early and go to school by bus.
On a school day, I get up early and have breakfast.
On a school day, I get up early in the morning.
On a school day, I get up at seven o'clock.
I go to bed at night.
